claims.statement: Slot correction mitigation ran but was applied to the wrong feed before affected feed was identified; orders remain stuck in 'allocated, awaiting pickup'.
Mitigation executed without satisfying m8_r_owner precondition: 'corrections must run only after the affected feed and its lag are identified.' This caused wrong-feed application and failure.
claims.limitation: Mitigation was reversible per m8_r_owner; failure is procedural not technical.

next_action.rationale: Identify the specific carrier feed affected by EXC-0921 orders and confirm its lag characteristics. This diagnostic satisfies the precondition (identify affected feed and its lag) that must be met before re-attempting slot correction. Once feed lag is confirmed, slot correction can be applied to the correct feed with expected outcome.
